This patient-first approach is what sets us apart as a leader in the healthcare industry. deep_read.description: Become a part of our caring community Humana is looking for a Senior Proofreader to help ensure every member, patient, and provider communication is accurate, clear, compliant, and consistent with brand standards. In this role, you will support high-volume marketing and operational work by reviewing content across digital, print, and direct-to-consumer channels before it reaches the people who rely on Humana for trusted health information. A typical day may include proofreading campaign materials, validating revisions against marked-up files, checking content for grammar, punctuation, formatting, accessibility, and brand consistency, and partnering with writers, designers, project managers, and quality assurance leaders to resolve issues before final delivery. The Senior Proofreader reviews customer-facing and internal communications to ensure content is error-free, consistent, and ready for production. This role supports quality assurance processes by verifying that creative and content deliverables meet approved copy, brand, accessibility, and regulatory standards. The work directly contributes to clearer member and patient experiences by reducing errors and improving confidence in Humana communications. The Senior Proofreader also helps teams maintain efficient workflows by identifying patterns, documenting issues, and supporting continuous improvement.
